fn-wind-02.front: Which slope flips to upslope first?
fn-wind-02.back: East faces. South is strongest near midday, west peaks mid afternoon.

fn-wind-03.front: When does up valley wind start?
fn-wind-03.back: Middle or late morning, after the whole valley warms. Peaks early afternoon.

fn-wind-04.front: What happens when a slope goes into shade?
fn-wind-04.back: Upslope dies, a brief calm, then gentle downslope flow.

fn-wind-06.back: About 3 to 8 km/h (2 to 5 mph). Very shallow.
